category: hosted API key management, key verification and rate limiting (API Management); a separate paid Compute product exists

free_tier.stated: Free API Management at USD 0 a month: 150,000 valid requests a month, 1,000 API keys, unlimited APIs, 7 days of request log retention and 30 days of audit log retention; team members need a paid API tier or Compute Pro or Business
free_tier.notes: Only valid key verifications and rate limit checks count. Rejected verifications do not count. A card is on file only to upgrade; the Free tier starts at USD 0. Compute is a separate paid product and is not part of this free allowance.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-key or per-request size cap is stated on the pricing, plans or limits pages read

retention.stated: Request logs are kept 7 days and audit logs 30 days on the Free API Management tier; a paid API tier owns both retention values (90 days each)
retention.notes: The 7 days is request log retention. Audit log retention on Free is 30 days. Log drains are included on no plan.

egress.terms: not applicable to API Management: the free offer is a key verification and rate limiting service reached over its HTTPS API, and no data egress quota is stated for it

interface_detail: Every API endpoint is an HTTP POST to api.unkey.com/v2/{service}.{procedure} with a root key in an Authorization Bearer header; /v2/liveness is a GET health route. An OpenAPI document is served at /openapi.yaml and a browsable reference at /reference. SDKs exist for TypeScript, Go and other languages.
tooling: The @unkey/api TypeScript SDK, the unkeyed Go SDK, HTTP POST calls to api.unkey.com and the dashboard at app.unkey.com
chaining: Issue keys and verify them from any service over HTTPS; combine with a separate API gateway or with Unkey Compute for deployment, which is a paid product outside the free allowance.

limits.value: 150,000 valid requests per month on Free
7 days of request logs and 30 days of audit logs on Free
If a workspace is still on Free 5 days after passing the quota, requests to the Unkey API are limited to 5 per minute until it upgrades
Team members are not included on the Free API tier; they need a paid API tier or Compute Pro or Business

binding_note: The 150,000 valid requests a month fills first for a live API; passing it emails the admins and a workspace still on Free 5 days later is cut to 5 API requests a minute. The Free tier also holds one user, since team members need a paid tier, and request logs are kept only 7 days.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-in form shows an Email field with a Continue with email button and Continue with Google and Continue with GitHub options; no phone or card is asked for to enter. The billing pages state a card is needed before upgrading, and the Free tier is USD 0. Whether a later dashboard step asks for a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Requests are not blocked on passing the quota immediately; admins are emailed and, if the workspace stays on Free 5 days later, the API is limited to 5 requests a minute until upgrade. Logs on Free are retained 7 days, so older failed verifications cannot be inspected.
confidence_note: Quotas, retention and the over-quota throttle are quoted from first-party billing and limits pages. The sign-in fields come from the first-party sign-in page. Any gate shown only after registration is unverified: behind a sign-up.
